evidence.name: Screen field: Reuse cached media
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Reuse cached media" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Reuse cached media
sections.description: When on, the screen reuses media it has already cached instead of re-downloading it, which can speed up loading for visitors on slow or flaky connections. Leave it off by default for standard web ad funnels, since there's nothing to reuse until assets are cached. Turn it on only if you ship pre-bundled assets or expect a lot of poor-connectivity traffic.
